paths.description: Requested bare host and its missing-page recovery state. Included because it is the exact supplied URL; it returns HTTP 404 and represents error recovery, not the news product.
Current news article template discovered from news.daum.net. Represents the host’s primary reading journey, metadata, related content, utilities, advertising, and network/runtime behavior.

findings.summary: The requested entry URL is an HTTP 404 rather than a usable news surface.
findings.evidence: curl recorded HTTP/2 404 for https://v.daum.net/; the screenshot shows only a recovery page.
findings.suggestedFix: Route the host root to a useful news landing page, or redirect it with a permanent HTTP redirect.

findings.summary: The article template is unusable at a 360 px viewport.
findings.evidence: The layout primitive measured scrollWidth 1168 against clientWidth 360 (808 px overflow), while the screenshot shows the headline and body clipped off-screen.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove fixed desktop minimum widths, use intrinsic/fluid sizing, and verify article reflow at narrow viewports.

findings.summary: The article ignores the user’s dark color preference.
findings.evidence: Under prefers-color-scheme: dark, the article screenshot remains a white surface; the root error page does switch to dark.
findings.suggestedFix: Apply color-scheme and preference-driven surface/text tokens consistently to the article template.

findings.summary: State changes do not use view transitions.
findings.evidence: The DOM/CSS probe found no active view-transition usage on the article’s search, translation, and related-news state changes.
findings.suggestedFix: Use same-document View Transitions for meaningful panel and navigation state changes, with reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Interactive overlays use legacy custom positioning and controls.
findings.evidence: The DOM has interactive search/translation panels but zero dialog, popover, details, CSS container rules, or CSS anchor positioning evidence.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover/dialog semantics and CSS anchor positioning with fallback positions for transient panels.

findings.summary: Article reading cannot complete on mobile because content is clipped.
findings.evidence: At 360x800 the headline, summary, and article table extend far beyond the right edge; the measured overflow is 808 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Treat the reading journey as a responsive acceptance test and remove desktop-only layout constraints.

findings.summary: Loading is far outside Core Web Vitals targets.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured FCP 8.9 s, LCP 11.3 s, Speed Index 11.9 s, TTI 36.5 s, and performance 0.49. The independent trace measured LCP 3.52 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize article content, shorten dependency chains, and defer nonessential ads, analytics, recommendations, and scripts.

findings.summary: The article ships a very heavy dependency and third-party payload.
findings.evidence: HAR captured 128 requests and 3,861,531 transferred bytes; 21 scripts cost 2.24 MB and 124 requests were classified third-party. A page JS and CSS file each exceeded 1.16 MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Split and conditionally load article features, trim unused code, defer below-fold modules, and reduce third-party dependencies.

findings.summary: Accessible names and document semantics are incomplete.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse accessibility scored 0.80 and found an unnamed Daum logo link, five untitled ad iframes, and no html lang; the probe also found 22 images without alt attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Set html lang, name the logo link and frames, and provide meaningful or empty alt text as appropriate.

findings.summary: Several controls and ad labels fail contrast minimums.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found 2.9:1 to 3:1 contrast for AD labels and selected tabs against their backgrounds, below 4.5:1.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust foreground/background tokens and verify normal, dark, and high-contrast states.

findings.summary: Zoom is disabled and important targets are undersized.
findings.evidence: The viewport contains maximum-scale=1,user-scalable=no; Lighthouse found 14x14 ad-info targets and the probe found a 16x18 tooltip button.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow user zoom and increase interactive hit areas to at least the guidance target size with adequate spacing.

findings.summary: The page logs asset errors and uses deprecated or poorly inspectable code.
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found multiple font CORS failures, a deprecated Topics API use, missing/failed source maps, inspector issues, and a BFCache failure.
findings.suggestedFix: Fix font CORS, remove deprecated API usage, publish valid source maps, and resolve BFCache/DevTools issues.

findings.summary: Public indexing signals are incomplete.
findings.evidence: The article is HTTP 200 but has no canonical link in the document probe; /robots.txt and /sitemap.xml both return the branded 404 document, and the bare target URL is also HTTP 404.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve valid robots.txt and sitemap.xml, keep canonical/status signals consistent, and redirect the bare host to a crawlable landing page.

findings.summary: The article has no meta description.
findings.evidence: The document probe and Lighthouse meta-description audit found no meta[name=description], although Open Graph description is present.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a concise page-specific meta description aligned with the visible article summary.

findings.summary: Browser-enforced security defenses are absent.
findings.evidence: The headers primitive found no CSP, HSTS, nosniff, clickjacking defense, Referrer-Policy, or Permissions-Policy. One first-party cookie is not Secure and all four use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP and defensive headers; make cookies Secure with the least-permissive SameSite and lifetime needed.

findings.summary: The article loads a broad tracking and advertising footprint.
findings.evidence: The tracker primitive observed 28 origins, 26 third-party origins, and DoubleClick/Google ad trackers; Lighthouse reported 11 third-party cookies.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimize trackers, gate nonessential collection behind informed consent, and batch/defer analytics.

findings.summary: Runtime dependencies fail even on the main article path.
findings.evidence: HAR recorded failed CORS font loads, blocked action/comment loaders, and aborted feedback calls; Lighthouse logged console errors.
findings.suggestedFix: Make optional dependencies conditional and failure-tolerant, and ensure core assets load with correct CORS and MIME behavior.

findings.summary: The document does not declare its Korean language or time-zone context.
findings.evidence: The article html lang and dir are empty. A publication time is rendered without an explicit zone while the product exposes translation across many languages.
findings.suggestedFix: Set lang="ko", use logical properties, and emit machine-readable zoned publication dates.

findings.summary: Search input assistance is disabled or unnamed.
findings.evidence: The search text input has no associated label or aria-label and uses autocomplete="off".
findings.suggestedFix: Give search a programmatic label and retain useful browser input assistance unless there is a documented reason not to.

findings.summary: Images are not delivered or scheduled efficiently.
findings.evidence: The images primitive found 27 missing dimensions, 28 below-fold images without lazy loading, 27 missing alt values, and no responsive srcset for the two article images.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve dimensions, lazy-load below-fold recommendations, and serve responsive modern image variants.

findings.summary: Third-party media and scripts exceed a proportionate article budget.
findings.evidence: The HAR transferred 3.86 MB for a text article, with 3.83 MB and 124 requests classified third-party; scripts alone transferred 2.24 MB.
findings.suggestedFix: Set an article page-weight/third-party budget and load ads, comments, live media, and recommendation modules only when needed.

findings.summary: The current memory footprint is large for a text article.
findings.evidence: Baseline heap summary reported 548,204 nodes and 35.69 MB self size. Ten translation-panel toggles added only 0.49 MB JS heap and DOM nodes stayed 939 to 938, so no repeated-interaction leak was observed.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce the initial widget/advertising object graph and keep regression tests for bounded heap and DOM size.
